original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. armada-poc has no license-hygiene check. scripts/check-license-hygiene.sh does not exist. .github/workflows/ci.yml has no license-hygiene job. The exophial gate command in .exophial/config.yaml does not run it. Operator order 2026-10-20.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. scripts/check-license-hygiene.sh exists. ci.yml lines 12-19 define a license-hygiene job that runs it. .exophial/config.yaml line 27 runs it in the gate command, and line 14 names it in a comment.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. Count matches of license-hygiene or license hygiene (case-insensitive) in the tracked tree with git grep; report the count as JSON field matches. Report whether scripts/check-license-hygiene.sh exists as JSON field script_exists. Expected: matches 0, script_exists false.
What constraints apply? State them in plain prose. Change only these three files. Keep every other CI job and gate step unchanged. Reference commit 167c5ad4 on branch exo/drop-license-check holds the exact change.
Where does this apply? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) armada-poc scripts/check-license-hygiene.sh, .github/workflows/ci.yml, .exophial/config.yaml
restatement: The license-hygiene check must be removed from armada-poc. The script scripts/check-license-hygiene.sh must not exist. The CI workflow .github/workflows/ci.yml must not define a license-hygiene job. The exophial gate in .exophial/config.yaml must not run or name it. Every other CI job and gate step stays unchanged. The tracked tree must hold zero case-insensitive matches of license-hygiene or license hygiene, and script_exists must be false.

.exophial/config.yaml does not run or name license-hygiene or license hygiene (case-insensitive) in the gate command or in any comment.
Every other CI job and gate step stays unchanged; ci.yml still defines its jobs and config.yaml still defines the gate command.

goal: Remove the license-hygiene script, its CI job, and its exophial gate step, and nothing else.
